meta.targetDefinition: Actual minutes played (minutes > 0) in Final games. DNP / 00-minute logs are excluded from the target.

featureNotes.expectedMinutes: Mean of prior played games (minutes > 0) as-of tipoff. DNP logs are skipped in minutes windows.
featureNotes.rates: sum(stat) / sum(minutes) over prior played games. Zero-minute logs do not enter either sum.
featureNotes.trackAMinutes: 0.7 * L10 played minutes + 0.3 * season played minutes (production Track A weights).
featureNotes.r1r2r3ExpectedMinutes: Track-A minutes blend. Sportsbook line is never an input.
featureNotes.countingTrackA: 0.7 * L10 counting avg + 0.3 * season counting avg over all prior Final logs (DNP zeros included), matching production Track A.
featureNotes.identityNote: Season played-minutes * season rate is close to, but not identical to, counting season avg because counting averages include DNP 0-stat games.
featureNotes.noLeakage: Prior games require start_time < target.start_time. Active-season ignores other seasons.
featureNotes.starterRole: analytics.game_starters is this-game observed starter (2025 only). Used as a split, never as a feature.
featureNotes.teamChange: Inferred from analytics.player_game_logs.team_id vs prior games. Observation of roster, not a trade timestamp.

productionChange: none — research only; live Track B.1 / Track A serving unchanged
